client_concern: Client was worried about the basement. They saw something that looked like efflorescence and had done an ERMI test at home (score 13.2). They wanted to know how big the problem was and where it came from. Office note: 'Please do a full diagnostic inspection'.

timeline.what: Client support (Staff A) books the inspection. The calendar entry holds the client concern, price and a note for the inspector (entry created Oct 1; its note says booked Sept 5).
Inspector visits: thermal camera, moisture meter, hygrometer, swab tests, attic and exterior check. 21 photos taken.
Inspection invoice INV-CASE01 created: $195 + HST = $220.35. Paid.
Admin writes the report from the inspector's notes and photos; second admin reviews it. Tracked as a 'Deliverables to complete' subtask in Asana.
Job card created automatically in 'MB Solutions: October 2026' with links to Close, FreshBooks client, invoice, estimate and report. Staff move it: Share Deliverables -> Collect Payment.
Client gets an email with a link to the report. Asana card moves to 'Follow Up'.
Lead + opportunity ($3,700, 50%) in Close. First automated SMS: 'I sent you the estimate... text me if anything doesn't make sense.'
Automated SMS offers 10% off the remediation.
'Checking in one last time' - also offers a post-remediation clearance report.
'Still interested, or should we close your case?'
Close sequence ends, task 'assign to CSP'. Support agent sends a personal SMS from Dialpad and posts a screenshot in Asana. Card closed.
No reply from client found. Estimate viewed, not accepted. Lead still 'Potential'.

findings: Basement: small discoloration under the sink, swab test positive for mold. No odor, no thermal anomalies, humidity and moisture normal.
Rest of the house checked for free: thermal anomalies on the top floor, in the living room below the roof and on the laundry room ceiling.
Both upstairs washrooms: discoloration on grout and silicone, standing water in the en-suite, failed ball-slope test in the shower, leaking tub faucet with high moisture below.
Attic: insulation uneven and heavily disturbed, visible discoloration.
Outside: poor drainage and a low spot (depression) by the main entrance.
recommendations: Roofer to check the roof above the living room

scope: Areas: two washrooms and the attic
Containment: plastic barriers + zipper doors, negative air when possible
Treatment: HEPA vacuum + manual cleaning, then 2 steps - stain removal, then eco fungicide (drywall ceilings, grout, tiles, attic trusses and sheathing)
Disinfection: HEPA vacuum + fogging of the contained area
Clearance: visual check + 3 instant swabs by the supervisor, written clearance certificate
Terms: 40% deposit to book, estimate valid 60 days, reconstruction not included
estimate.status: Viewed by client, not accepted yet
